test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Sakshi said that she would do it then or never.

options.text: Sakshi said, "I will do it then or never."
Sakshi said, "I have to do it now or never."
Sakshi said, "I will do it now or never"
Sakshi said, "I would do it then or never."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Sakshi said that she would do it then or never.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she would do it then" becomes "I will do it now"**
 
 
• Indirect future tense "she would" is converted to direct future tense "I will."
 
• Time expression "then" is converted to "now" in direct speech.
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period "."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I will do it now or never," said Sakshi.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "I will do il then or never."

 
 
• Typographical error in the word "il" instead of "it".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "I have to do it now or never."
 
 
• Changes the modal verb from "would" to "have to," altering the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "I would do it then or never."
 
 
• Retains the indirect speech modal verb "would," instead of converting to "will" for direct speech.
